title: Website deploy-local.sh should allow the expected alias-attach diff on a certificate deploy
description:
In the website repo, deploy-local.sh requires --allow-infra-changes on a certificate deploy even though the alias-attach diff is expected. Allow that expected diff without the flag; still fail on other infra changes.

Feature: Website local deploy
  Scenario: Certificate deploy
    Given the diff contains only the alias attach
    When deploy-local.sh runs without --allow-infra-changes
    Then it proceeds
right_now_summary: deploy-local.sh still requires the flag for the expected alias-attach diff during certificate deploys.
